sourceSecurity.gitleaks: Any detected secret blocks the check. Secret output is redacted.
sourceSecurity.semgrep: ERROR findings from the pinned local policy and pinned semgrep CLI block the check.
sourceSecurity.trivy: Fixable and unfixable HIGH and CRITICAL source, IaC, and secret findings block the check.
sourceSecurity.osv: CVSS 7.0 or higher blocks the check. Missing or malformed severity data fails closed. Lower severity advisories are reported but do not block.

infrastructure.checkov: Any failed enabled Terraform policy check blocks the check.
infrastructure.tflint: Any configured Terraform lint error blocks the check.
infrastructure.shellcheck: ShellCheck errors and warnings block the check.

image: Trivy HIGH or CRITICAL image vulnerabilities block publication; an SBOM is required before push.
exceptions: Do not disable a scanner or suppress a finding to obtain a green check. Document scoped false positives with owner, reason, expiration date, and a reviewed policy change.
